title: The alarmone pGpp inhibits translation through GTP depletion.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: GEO (Gene Expression Omnibus) metadata for GSE319724 and GSE319727: 12 samples each, one featureCounts gene-count file per series. Downloaded GSE319724_combinedCounts.txt.gz (175 KB): 4,443 lines (~4,441 Bacillus subtilis genes) by 12 columns = 2 strains (pGpp-inducible KAE60, (p)ppGpp-inducible KAE74) x 3 time points (0/10/20 min) x 2 replicates.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: That GSE319727 has the same design for the nahA-deletion strains; translation, polysome and GTP measurements (biochemistry figures, not deposited as tables). Europe PMC supplement listing timed out, so it was not retrievable.

a1_downloadable.note: GEO count matrices download openly; checked one file.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: No outcome column; the only labels are experimental conditions (strain, time point). Any per-gene target such as 'responds to pGpp' would have to be constructed from differential expression on 2 replicates.

a3_inputs_present.note: Gene names and coordinates present in the count file.

a4_units_stated.note: Raw read counts from featureCounts, stated in the file header.

a5_enough_rows.note: 24 RNA-seq samples total (12 verified in one file, 12 per GEO listing for the other); far below 400.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: 12 samples in the downloaded file match the GEO sample list.

a8_label_provenance.note: Counts are measured; no derived label exists to assess.

honest_claim_h3: With 24 bulk RNA-seq samples from one bacterial strain background, no model-learnable claim is supported; this is a mechanistic biochemistry paper.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use bacterial gene expression after stress-signal induction to predict which genes respond to the pGpp alarm signal versus its relatives.
plain_idea.train_on: Read counts for ~4,441 Bacillus subtilis genes across 24 samples (2 strains x 3 time points x 2 replicates, two experiments).
plain_idea.predict: Whether a gene changes expression under pGpp versus (p)ppGpp production, which would have to be computed from differential expression rather than measured directly.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Would show which genes distinguish the alarmone species, but this is a standard differential-expression analysis, not an ML problem.

ml_idea: None viable: tiny time-course RNA-seq supporting a mechanism paper; no measured label to predict.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated; rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Count samples in GEO: 24, already done.

verdict_reason: Fails A2 and A5: 24 bulk RNA-seq samples (verified 12 in the downloaded count file) with only condition labels; the other results are biochemistry assays not deposited as tables.
